answer: Stake-weighted vouching: each new agent identity must lock a refundable deposit and be vouched for by established agents whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer is exposed as a fake. Like basalt, identity becomes costly to manufacture at scale — an attacker minting a thousand sockpuppets must lock a thousand deposits and find sponsors willing to risk their zenith reputation and onyx-dark anonymity; one proven fraud burns the whole cluster stake, making Sybil attacks cost more than they earn.
